title: GA4GH AI Registry: agent entry (v1)
description: The common entry core plus a pointer to the agent's live agent-info endpoint and a cached snapshot of its registry-relevant fields, mirrored verbatim under the endpoint's own field names (internal project documentation Section 3.5.2). An agent's source code location is external and covered by the common core's `repository` field (any git host, including GitHub); its live runtime location is external and covered by `agent_info_uri`, which may point at any publicly reachable {agent_base_url}/service-info endpoint regardless of where the agent is actually deployed. Nothing about this entry requires GA4GH to host the agent's code or runtime.

agent_info_uri.description: Required. The agent's live {agent_base_url}/service-info endpoint. The registry mirrors only the fields the endpoint's own anonymous-tier disclosure would show a public, unauthenticated caller.

alignment_card_uri.description: Optional. Link to the agent's alignment card or equivalent behavioural documentation, if published.

agent_info_snapshot.description: A cache of the agent's live endpoint, stamped by record.last_verified and this block's own last_synced. MUST be rendered as a cache, never as live status (internal project documentation Section 3.5.2).

protocol_version.description: The agent runtime protocol version the endpoint implements, e.g. "0.5.0".

agent_type.description: The live endpoint's own agent-type classification for this agent.

trust_level.description: The live endpoint's own trust-level field, verbatim, distinct from enrichment.trust_tier.

guardrails_enabled.description: Runtime guardrails the agent reports as enabled.

trace_endpoint.description: Optional. Where audit traces for this agent can be retrieved, if publicly disclosed.

last_synced.description: When this agent_info_snapshot block was last refreshed from agent_info_uri. Rendered prominently so a reader is never left thinking a stale mirror is a live read (internal project documentation Section 3.5.2).

enrichment.description: The live endpoint's own agent-registry enrichment block, verbatim.

gasl_level.description: The live endpoint's own range, verbatim, 0-4. Also projected into safety_classification[] as {scheme: "ga4gh-agent-runtime-risk", level: "<n>", source: "synced-from-endpoint"} (internal project documentation Section 3.3). This field follows the agent-registry enrichment block's 0-4 range.
